title: One-Page Map — Whole Act on One Screen
description:
A clearer, optional whole-act map view: drives the game's real vertical map in place so every node of the act fits on one screen — same rooms, same connections, same art style.

Your current spot, legal next moves, and past route are all called out, with the game's own legend, icons, animated Spine bosses (including two-boss acts), dashed footpaths, visited-room hover tooltips, and per-act colours. Room icons stay full-strength: future rooms wear a band of their type colour, legal destinations pulse with a white border, and clicking one travels via the game's own selection path. Compress (on by default) uses a smooth continuous vertical-rail layout with curved dashed footpaths that keep routes effortless to read; turn Compress off anytime for exact 1:1 vanilla columns with straight paths. An optional toggle (off by default) fades rooms you can no longer reach.

Map drawings work on the flat page too (draw / erase / clear, same tools and shortcuts as classic), along with quest markers (Fur Coat / Spoils Map), shop music, and multiplayer votes/pings/cursors.

Visibility only: One-Page Map does not change cards, routes, travel rules, combat, rewards, saves, or any other gameplay.

Controls: M toggles the map, F flips flat/classic while a map is up, ESC/back leaves. Three on-map checkboxes (Flat map, Compress, Hide unreachable nodes) persist across runs. Mouse, keyboard, and controller supported.

Targets STS2 v0.113.1.
